author: gpt-6
visual_review: A centered circular head, paired shoulders, rounded monitor, and stand read cleanly at 48 px in both themes. The head outline ends at y=21 and the shoulders begin at y=29, giving the required 4-unit visible gap.
omissions: The shoulder endpoints meet the monitor's bottom border because the source's free-floating shoulder ends cannot preserve the 4-unit head gap and fit with the stand at SOLO48 scale.
construction_reference: The shared human_ref/user.svg supplied the round head and symmetric shoulder construction; Lucide monitor and user-round originals and atomic-debug supplied the rounded screen, centered stand, and avatar layout.
